Wait the function signature says categories?: "vegan" | "gluten-free"[]; but it expects an array of strings? The type says categories?: "vegan" | "gluten-free"[], which seems ambiguous. Probably categories can be an array of strings containing either "vegan" or "gluten-free". But we want vegetarian and gluten-free. The function only supports "vegan" or "gluten-free". There's no "vegetarian". So we can't request vegetarian. We could request "gluten-free" category. But the user asked for vegetarian and gluten-free. We might respond that we cannot get vegetarian specifically. But maybe we can interpret vegetarian as vegan? No, vegetarian includes dairy and eggs. The function doesn't support that. So we should explain limitation.

Thus we will call the function with categories ["gluten-free"]. Then we will return the result.
